subject: Export to BigQuery fails with permission error
description: Our scheduled export to BigQuery stopped with 'permission denied' after we rotated the service account.
latest_comment: Fixed: the new service account needed the BigQuery Data Editor role. Exports running again. (agent Sam Ortiz)

subject: iOS events missing after SDK v3 upgrade
description: Since our iOS app moved to SDK 3.0.1 on 28 August, screen and purchase events from iOS are down about 60%. Android is normal. Call me on +49 30 5550 1187 if you need logs.
latest_comment: Engineering confirmed a batching bug in iOS SDK 3.0.1 that drops events when the app goes to the background. Fix ships in 3.0.3, expected 28 October. Events lost before the fix cannot be recovered. (agent Sam Ortiz)

subject: Experiment results don't match our warehouse
description: Conversion uplift for the checkout test shows 4.1% in Cairnpath but 2.7% in our warehouse.
latest_comment: Explained: Cairnpath uses a 7-day attribution window, the warehouse query used same-session. With the same window both show 3.9%. Customer happy. (agent Priya Nair)

subject: SAML SSO needed before rollout to 60 more users
description: Our security team won't approve 60 more users from the three new brands without SAML SSO through Okta. This blocks the rollout we discussed with Tom.
latest_comment: Logged with Product as a request (SSO is on the roadmap for Q1, no date). Suggested the customer's security team review our SOC 2 report meanwhile. (agent Priya Nair)

subject: How do I build a cohort of trial users?
description: I want to compare trial users who invited a teammate with those who didn't.
latest_comment: Sent a step-by-step guide and a link to the advanced workshop on 18 August. (agent Sam Ortiz)
